teacherGuide.conceptGu: 5× table = count by 5s. Always ends in 0 or 5. Clock connection: 5min marks. One hand = 5 fingers. Easy pattern to remember!
teacherGuide.conceptEn: 5x always ends in 0 or 5. Clock minutes use 5x table.
teacherGuide.conceptDa: 5-tabellen slutter altid på 0 eller 5. Minutterne på uret tæller også i 5-tabellen.
teacherGuide.storyGu: 'Clock: 1 hour mark = 5 minutes! 2 marks = 10 minutes! 12 marks × 5 = 60 minutes = 1 hour! 5× table = clock math!'
teacherGuide.storyEn: Clock hands! 1 mark = 5 min, 2 marks = 10 min. 12 marks * 5 = 60 min = 1 hour! 5x is clock math!
teacherGuide.storyDa: Urets minutter! 1 markering = 5 min, 2 markeringer = 10 min. 12 markeringer * 5 = 60 min (1 time). 5-tabellen er urskivens hemmelighed!
teacherGuide.scriptGu: 'High five! One hand = 5. Two hands = 10. Three children = 15 fingers! Count by 5s!'
teacherGuide.scriptEn: High five! One hand = 5. Two hands = 10. Skip counting by 5s is fun!
teacherGuide.scriptDa: High five! Én hånd = 5. To hænder = 10. Tre børn = 15 fingre! At tælle i 5-tabellen er let!
teacherGuide.tipsGu: 💡 Clock face practice: point to each number, multiply by 5. Always right!
teacherGuide.tipsEn: 💡 High-five skip counting. Highlight that 5x tables always end in 0 or 5.
teacherGuide.tipsDa: 💡 Lav high-fives og tæl i 5-spring. Vis barnet, at alle svar i 5-tabellen ender på enten 0 eller 5.
